Article 11.1: Rules Cheat Sheet (All Account Types)

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

OG accounts are no longer sold. Existing OG accounts keep their rules.

Evaluation: Must-Know Rules
Rule	Standard OG	Express OG	Std MAX	Exp MAX
Min days	7 trading days	4 trading days	5 winning days	2 winning days
Consistency	40%	25%	40%	50%
Drawdown type	Realized trailing	Realized trailing	EOD	Realized trailing
DLL	None	None	Soft breach	None
News trading	OK	OK	OK	OK
Activation fee	$120	$120	$120	$120
Exhibition	YES	YES	NO	NO
Funded: Must-Know Rules
Rule	OG Funded	Std MAX Funded	Exp MAX Funded
Buffer built in	Exhibition	Funded (EOD)	Funded (Unrealized)
Drawdown	Static +$100	EOD + Static +$100	Unrealized → Static
DLL	None	Soft breach	None
Consistency (sim)	40%	40%	25%
Consistency (live)	None	None	None
5 winning days	No	No	YES per payout
Profit split (sim)	80/20	80/20	80/20
Profit split (Institution)	90/10	90/10	90/10
Payout Quick Reference
Account Size	Cap (Payouts 1–3)	Cap (Payouts 4+)
$25,000	$750	$900
$50,000	$1,000	$1,250
$100,000	$1,500	$1,750
$150,000	$1,750	$2,000
$250,000	$2,000	$2,500

Accounts purchased before October 22, 2026 and not reset since keep the payout caps they were purchased with (Article 5.3).

Rule	Detail
Minimum withdrawal	$500
Maximum per payout event	$10,000 per user across all accounts
Payment methods	Rise, PayPal, Wise: no fees
Processing time	Same-day
Consistency reset	Per account after each payout
Best day P&L reset	NO: never resets
Critical Trading Hours
Requirement	Time
All positions FLAT by (daily)	4:50 PM EST
Can reopen positions (daily)	6:00 PM EST
Weekend flat (Friday)	4:50 PM EST
Reopen (Sunday)	6:00 PM EST
Early close (holiday)	1 minute before market close
T1 news blackout	1 min before + during + 1 min after event
Common Violations Quick Reference
What Happened	Consequence	What to Do
Breach trailing drawdown (eval)	Account failed	Reset via dashboard: $100 (Standard MAX) or $114 to $620 (STEADY, by account size)
Breach trailing drawdown (exhibition)	Account failed	Pay exhibition reset fee within 7 trading days, or restart evaluation
News trade in exhibition/funded	Liquidated, profits forfeited	Contact support: no recovery option
Held position past 4:50 PM EST	Account liquidated and failed	(System will automatically flatten your position at 4:50 PM ET. Do not rely on this)
Exceeded contract limits	Account failed	Contact support
DLL hit (Standard MAX)	Session lockout only, not failed	Wait until next session at 6:00 PM EST
More than 5 copy-traded accounts	All copy-traded accounts reset	Reduce to 5 or fewer
More than 30% of a trading day's trades held 5 seconds or less (accounts purchased or reset on or after October 22, 2026)	Profit from that day's profitable trades held 5 seconds or less is not eligible for payout. Account not failed.	See Article 3.8
